vendors.name: GitGuardian
vendors.offering: Secrets detection across Git, CI/CD, containers, collaboration tools; NHI governance; ggshield CLI
vendors.pricing: Free up to 25 devs; Growth/Enterprise per active developer, price not public

vendors.name: GitHub Secret Protection
vendors.offering: Secret scanning, push protection, custom patterns, validity checks for GitHub repositories
vendors.pricing: $19 per active committer/month (Team/Enterprise); basic scanning free on public repos

vendors.name: TruffleHog Enterprise
vendors.offering: Verified secret detection across 20+ SDLC sources with central UI and monitoring
vendors.pricing: Custom quote; AWS Marketplace listing shows $100,000 per 12 months

vendors.name: Semgrep Secrets
vendors.offering: Secrets detection with validation, part of Semgrep AppSec platform
vendors.pricing: $15 per contributor/month add-on; free tier up to 10 contributors for Code/Supply Chain

vendors.name: Aikido Security
vendors.offering: All-in-one AppSec platform including secrets detection, SAST, SCA, IaC
vendors.pricing: Basic-10 users $3,780/year on AWS Marketplace; free developer tier

vendors.name: GitLab Secret Detection
vendors.offering: Pipeline and push secret detection built into GitLab
vendors.pricing: Bundled; available across Free, Premium, Ultimate tiers with advanced features in Ultimate

vendors.name: Amazon Inspector Code Security
vendors.offering: Repository and Lambda code scans including embedded secrets
vendors.pricing: $0.15 per repository scan per scan type; 15-day free trial

paid_market_gaps.gap: GitHub free tier lacks custom patterns, generic patterns and validity checks; these require paid Secret Protection per committer.
GitGuardian limits CI log and file storage scanning, custom detectors and self-hosting to its Enterprise tier.
Azure DevOps secret scanning via Defender needs a GitHub Advanced Security license or paid Defender CSPM plan.
Broad multi-source verified scanning (TruffleHog Enterprise) is quote-only, listed at $100k/year, leaving mid-market without transparent pricing.

wtp_evidence: Public prices buyers pay: GitHub Secret Protection $19 per active committer/month; AWS Marketplace lists TruffleHog Enterprise at $100,000/12 months and Aikido (all-in-one AppSec incl. secrets) from $3,780/year for Basic-10; but strong free OSS and free tiers dampen spend on standalone secrets detection.
bundling_note: GitHub gives push protection and provider-pattern scanning free on public repos, GitLab bundles secret detection in every tier, and AWS Inspector includes secrets in code scans.
summary: Crowded, heavily bundled market with mature OSS (TruffleHog, Gitleaks) and free tiers. Only narrow openings: affordable multi-source/CI-log scanning for mid-market non-GitHub shops, or remediation/rotation workflows beyond detection.
